The correct answer is option 2 ie 5 days.

Work by B in 1 day = 7 units

Work remaining = (10.5 - 8 ) × 10 = 25 units

= (60/100) × 25 = 15 units

= (60/100) × 25 = 15 इकाई

A द्वारा लिया गया समय = 15/3 = 5 दिन

The correct answer is option 2 ie 57.

= (sum of 13 numbers) / 13 = 47

Avg. of first 3 numbers = 39

Avg. of next 7 numbers = 49

Let the 12th number be x.

Then, 11th number = 2x.

13th number = x+3
